related.title: ARPACK：位移反轉映射與原問題殘差
related.titleEn: ARPACK: shift-invert mappings and original-problem residuals
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：覆蓋與值皆正確才接受；單一總和可能掩蓋排列錯誤。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept only correct coverage and values; a single global sum can conceal permutations.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「ARPACK：位移反轉映射與原問題殘差」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付雙向譜映射、位移矩陣對角值、原殘差與接近奇異的反例。
related.differenceEn: Investigate ARPACK: shift-invert mappings and original-problem residuals using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver forward and inverse spectral mappings, shifted diagonal entries, original residuals and a near-singularity counterexample showing why transformed magnitude is not an accuracy certificate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: i=6、j=10 除區塊二取 floor，得到區塊 (3,5)，再循環到程序 (1,2)。
以差值 0.5 得 μ=2，再用 σ+1/μ 回復五；計另一特徵值二的映射以確認目標區域。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Divide i=6 and j=10 by block size two and take floors, obtaining block coordinates (3,5). Cycle these across the process grid, retaining intermediate coordinates so each ownership transformation is auditable.
Use difference 0.5 to obtain mu=2 and recover five through the inverse map. Also transform eigenvalue two, comparing magnitudes to understand why the targeted eigenvalue becomes prominent.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Xarray：月長權重、缺測分母與日曆平均
related.titleEn: Xarray: month-length weighting, missing-data denominators and calendars
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：覆蓋與值皆正確才接受；單一總和可能掩蓋排列錯誤。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept only correct coverage and values; a single global sum can conceal permutations.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Xarray：月長權重、缺測分母與日曆平均」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付日曆與月長表、雙遮罩加權算例、覆蓋率及缺測政策。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Xarray: month-length weighting, missing-data denominators and calendars using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver calendar and month-length tables, consistently masked weighted calculations, coverage fractions and a missing-data policy distinguishing observed-period summaries from complete seasonal estimates.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: i=6、j=10 除區塊二取 floor，得到區塊 (3,5)，再循環到程序 (1,2)。
計分子 310+560+1240 與九十天分母；和月等權平均比較，保留差異理由。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Divide i=6 and j=10 by block size two and take floors, obtaining block coordinates (3,5). Cycle these across the process grid, retaining intermediate coordinates so each ownership transformation is auditable.
Calculate numerator 310+560+1240 and denominator ninety days. Compare with an equal-month average and explain how differing month lengths change the result even when no data is missing.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
